about: Named, measured exceptions to Harry's rule (20 Oct 2026) 'no body part inside another' for tools/motionref/body_overlap.mts --gate. Each one is allowed up to maxCm (the worst measured on today's body, B5b's f2/f3 and b4 after B5c, + 0.3 cm). A new overlap, or a deeper one, fails the gate. Remove an entry when its fix lands.

exceptions.reason: The hip fold: the top of the thigh against the belly and buttock at the hip joint, worst in kneeling, sitting, dives and tackles. Skin at the hip of a skinned body, and the leg clips. Not B5c's arms work; to fix: leg clips (hip flexion limits) and the bodies' hip weights.

Inner thighs pressing together standing and walking: Style A thighs are thick for the capture's narrow stance. Real thighs touch; hidden by the shorts. To fix: wider stance in the leg clips or slimmer inner thighs (bodies).

Legs: the knee fold in deep bends (kneel, get-up, sit) and feet or shins brushing in narrow steps (side steps, turns, the walk). The capture's gait is narrower than our bodies' legs. To fix: leg clips (gait width, knee bend limits). Not in B5c's lane.

The upper arm against the lat and the side of the chest just below the armpit (15-25 cm from the shoulder joint): the bodies' upper arms are thick for their chests. Clearing it from the clips spreads every arm 20-35 deg out (tried: it looked wrong). To fix: the bodies (slimmer inner upper arm / lat at the armpit), B5b.
The wrist and elbow folds just beyond their joint zones (a bent wrist, a deep elbow bend): skin folding at a joint.
